upstream_questions.name: upstream_questions
upstream_questions.info: Optionally chain another Kev Question node here, or wire all Question nodes directly to the Core Engine.

table_schema.name: option_key
table_schema.description: Option name sent to Kev (e.g., billing, technical, account)

table_schema.name: description
table_schema.description: Description of what belongs in this option (leave blank for null)

table_schema.name: not_for
table_schema.description: Optional boundary rule for what does NOT belong in this option

table_schema.name: route_alias
table_schema.description: Optional custom label emitted on the Router if this option wins

value.description: Charges, refunds, invoices, payment failures, and plan changes.

Login issues, password resets, profile updates, and team permissions.
value.not_for: SSO or SCIM setup, which goes to technical.

value.description: Ambiguous, multi-issue, or out-of-scope requests needing human triage.

choice_options_table.info: Define your mutually exclusive options. Leave 'description' blank to send null when 'option_key' is self-explanatory. Fill 'not_for' to auto-build structured boundary criteria.

code.name: code

instructions.name: instructions

low_confidence_label.name: low_confidence_label
low_confidence_label.info: Route label emitted when confidence is below Minimum Confidence Threshold.

min_confidence.name: min_confidence
min_confidence.info: If Kev's choice confidence is below this cutoff, the question routes to Low-Confidence Label.

question_id.name: question_id
question_id.info: Unique identifier for this Choice question (e.g., 'department', 'intent', 'topic').
